scope: IMF statistical data and general site terms
summary: Statistical data terms require accurate attribution and disclosure of material transformations. The policy separately requests permission for potential commercial reuse and prohibits automated bulk downloading without explicit permission. These clauses require source/use-specific review; do not treat the archive as unrestricted open data.

scope: World Bank produced open datasets and third-party exceptions
summary: CC BY 4.0 is the default for World Bank produced open datasets; attribution and disclosure of changes apply. Third-party, custom, external and ODbL licenses may differ. The actual dataset metadata controls; no blanket license is assigned to every WDI or Data360 input.
